blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A World Bank-funded initiative is providing P97.91 million for agricultural infrastructure, enterprise development, and water and irrigation to develop the coffee industry in the Daraghuyan Ancestral Domain in Bukidnon. The Department of Agriculture (DA) and WB aim to enhance farm-to-market access, post-harvest handling, processing capacity, and access to essential agricultural services in the […]...
